BiblicalUsage: Mohar is the bride-price, the payment a man offers for a wife — Shechem names any dowry for Dinah, the law sets the price when a maid is not given in marriage, and Saul asks a hundred foreskins of the Philistines for Michal.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the price shows how seriously marriage was weighed: a wife was not taken lightly, and the cost said so.
